detail: Baton needs M03's worktree @TMP@/Fixture-M03 to stand on the commit that last changed docs/milestones/M03.md on main, because the session reads its brief in that worktree. Its HEAD does not contain that commit. Bring main into the branch yourself: git -C '@TMP@/Fixture-M03' merge main
